formal_statement: ∀ (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (k : ℕ), (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ k) → ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) → ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinKLine V), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinKDerivation k PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinKSemWeak ((fun C => PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.linKOfClause C) '' (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V))) π ∧ (∅ : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinKLine V) ∈ π ∧ π.length ≤ 2 * F.card + 1
plain_statement: In the system whose lines are disjunctions of conjunctions of at most k linear equations mod 2, with cut, and-introduction and FULL semantic weakening, every unsatisfiable CNF of width at most k with m clauses has a refutation of at most 2m + 1 lines: the line of the terms 'clause i is false' is a tautology, hence a weakening of an axiom, and one cut against each clause empties it. This is why Res(k,+) is defined with termwise weakening. Found by a pricing leg of seat-pcx-1; not known to us from a source.
title: Res(k,+) with full semantic weakening is trivial: every unsatisfiable CNF of width at most k with m clauses is refuted in 2m + 1 lines
